newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL gives P1+ rating for BPL.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL gives P1+ rating for BPL.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said in a statement on Wednesday that the 'P1+' rating assigned to 100 million rupees commercial paper programme of Blow Plast Limited (BPL) has been reaffirmed indicating that the safety regarding timely payment on the instrument is very strong.
It also said that the rating reflects BPL's strong market position in the luggage business and efficient working capital management.

BPL maintains adequate cushion in terms of unutilised bank limits which can be drawn to meet short term obligations. BPL also has the comfort of sufficient liquidity in the form of net lending in the Intercorporate Deposit (ICD) market and a small investment portfolio, it said.
